properties.name: oncebox.thread-pool-size
properties.description: Number of threads running the oncebox schedulers. Defaults to the number of available processors, at most 5.

properties.name: oncebox.schema.mode
properties.description: How oncebox creates its tables at startup: 'flyway' or 'liquibase' run the bundled migrations, 'dev' runs the plain scripts, 'none' leaves the schema to the application.

properties.name: oncebox.distributed-lock.lock-at-least-for
properties.description: Minimum time a scheduler keeps its job lock after a run. Ignored while 'resolve-by-polling-properties' is on.

properties.name: oncebox.distributed-lock.lock-at-most-for
properties.description: Maximum time a job lock is held before another instance may take it over. Ignored while 'resolve-by-polling-properties' is on.

properties.name: oncebox.distributed-lock.resolve-by-polling-properties
properties.description: Whether the lock durations of each job are derived from its polling properties instead of 'lock-at-least-for' and 'lock-at-most-for'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Whether the outbox is enabled. Any 'oncebox.outbox' property turns it on unless this is set to false, and then 'sender' and 'events' are required.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.sender.type
properties.description: Broker the outbox publishes to. Required when the outbox is enabled.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.sender.bean-name
properties.description: Name of the KafkaTemplate or RabbitTemplate bean the outbox publishes through. When not set, the single template bean of that type is used.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.sender.emergency-timeout
properties.description: How long the outbox waits for a batch to be sent before giving up on it. Must be shorter than 'stuck-recovery.max-batch-processing-time'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.events
properties.description: Outbox event types keyed by event type, each with a required 'topic' and optional 'batch-size', 'max-retries', 'polling' and 'backoff' that override 'defaults'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.batch-size
properties.description: Number of events an event type publishes in one run, unless the event type sets its own.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.max-retries
properties.description: Number of failed sends after which an event is marked as failed, unless the event type sets its own.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.type
properties.description: How the outbox publishing of an event type is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the outbox publishing of an event type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the outbox publishing of an event type, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the outbox publishing of an event type, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the outbox publishing of an event type, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the outbox publishing of an event type grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.backoff.enabled
properties.description: Whether a failed send is retried after a growing delay rather than on the next run.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.backoff.delay
properties.description: Delay before the first retry of a failed send.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.defaults.backoff.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the retry delay grows by after each failed send. Values below 1 fall back to the default.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of stuck events returned to pending in one run.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.max-batch-processing-time
properties.description: How long an event may stay in progress before it is treated as stuck and returned to pending. Must be longer than 'sender.emergency-timeout'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.type
properties.description: How the stuck event recovery is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the stuck event recovery.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the stuck event recovery, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the stuck event recovery, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the stuck event recovery, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.stuck-recovery.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the stuck event recovery grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.enabled
properties.description: Whether outbox clean-up deletes its expired rows on a schedule. On by default once the outbox is enabled; when off, the table grows without limit.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of rows outbox clean-up deletes in one run.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.ttl
properties.description: How long a row is kept before outbox clean-up deletes it.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.type
properties.description: How the outbox clean-up is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the outbox clean-up.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the outbox clean-up, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the outbox clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the outbox clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.clean-up.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the outbox clean-up grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.enabled
properties.description: Whether failed outbox events are moved to the dead letter queue.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.batch-size
properties.description: Number of events moved in one run, unless 'transfer-to' or 'transfer-from' sets its own.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.type
properties.description: How the dead letter queue transfers is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the dead letter queue transfers.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the dead letter queue transfers, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the dead letter queue transfers, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the dead letter queue transfers, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the dead letter queue transfers grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.batch-size
properties.description: Number of failed events moved to the dead letter queue in one run. Defaults to 'dlq.batch-size'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.batch-size
properties.description: Number of events moved back from the dead letter queue to the outbox in one run. Defaults to 'dlq.batch-size'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.type
properties.description: Polling 'type' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.type'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Polling 'initial-delay' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.initial-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'fixed-delay' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'min-fixed-delay' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'max-fixed-delay' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.max-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-to.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Polling 'multiplier' of the transfer-to job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.multiplier'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.type
properties.description: Polling 'type' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.type'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Polling 'initial-delay' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.initial-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'fixed-delay' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'min-fixed-delay' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Polling 'max-fixed-delay' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.max-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.transfer-from.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Polling 'multiplier' of the transfer-from job. Defaults to 'dlq.polling.multiplier'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.enabled
properties.description: Whether dead letter queue clean-up deletes its expired rows on a schedule. On by default once the dead letter queue is enabled; when off, the table grows without limit.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of rows dead letter queue clean-up deletes in one run.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.ttl
properties.description: How long a row is kept before dead letter queue clean-up deletes it.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.type
properties.description: How the dead letter queue clean-up is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the dead letter queue clean-up.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the dead letter queue clean-up, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the dead letter queue clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the dead letter queue clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.dlq.clean-up.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the dead letter queue clean-up grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether the outbox registers its Micrometer metrics.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.metrics.gauge.enabled
properties.description: Whether the outbox registers gauges that count stored rows, which query the database. Requires 'metrics.enabled'.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.metrics.gauge.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether the the outbox gauges cache their counts instead of querying the database on every scrape.

properties.name: oncebox.outbox.metrics.gauge.cache.ttls
properties.description: Exactly three cache TTLs, for the total count, the count by status and the count by event type and status. Any other number of values falls back to the default.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.enabled
properties.description: Whether the inbox that deduplicates consumed events is enabled.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.source.type
properties.description: Broker the inbox consumes from. Required when the inbox is enabled.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.mappings
properties.description: Classes of the consumed event payloads, keyed by event type.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.enabled
properties.description: Whether inbox clean-up deletes its expired rows on a schedule. On by default once the inbox is enabled; when off, the table grows without limit.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of rows inbox clean-up deletes in one run.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.ttl
properties.description: How long a row is kept before inbox clean-up deletes it.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.type
properties.description: How the inbox clean-up is scheduled: 'fixed' waits 'fixed-delay' between runs, 'adaptive' moves the delay between 'min-fixed-delay' and 'max-fixed-delay' by 'multiplier' as runs find work or not.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first run of the inbox clean-up.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between runs of the inbox clean-up, used only by the 'fixed' type.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.min-fixed-delay
properties.description: Shortest delay between runs of the inbox clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.max-fixed-delay
properties.description: Longest delay between runs of the inbox clean-up, used only by the 'adaptive' type. Cannot be shorter than 'min-fixed-delay'.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.clean-up.polling.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the 'adaptive' delay of the inbox clean-up grows by after a run that found no work. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether ids of consumed events are cached to skip a database lookup on a repeat. Off when the 'cache' section is absent, on once any of its properties is set.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.cache.cache-name
properties.description: Name of the Spring cache holding consumed event ids. Required when the cache is enabled.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether the inbox registers its Micrometer metrics.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.metrics.gauge.enabled
properties.description: Whether the inbox registers gauges that count stored rows, which query the database. Requires 'metrics.enabled'.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.metrics.gauge.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether the the inbox gauges cache their counts instead of querying the database on every scrape.

properties.name: oncebox.inbox.metrics.gauge.cache.ttls
properties.description: Exactly three cache TTLs, for the total count, the count by status and the count by event type and status. Any other number of values falls back to the default.
